purpose: Scroll-driven letter-reveal quote section, unique to /linkedin-automation.

motion.reducedMotionFallback: full quote text renders immediately and statically, no letter-by-letter scroll-tied reveal
motion.note: Word-by-word reveal. p = (scrollY - sectionTop) / (sectionHeight - innerHeight). Each of the 26 words owns 1/26 of p and its letters split that slice evenly: s = (k + j/n)/26, e = (k + (j+1)/n)/26. p <= s: rgba(255,255,255,.4) at opacity .7; s < p < e: #fff, opacity .7 -> 1; p >= e: #fff, opacity 1 -> .7 over [e, 1]. Supersedes the per-letter formula in spec/pages/landing.md:553 (M6), which drifted by up to 10 letters mid-quote against live.
